# Colourful Indian Holidays

Also spelled "Colorful Indian Holidays". Not related to Holi or generic "colourful India" festival content: this is a Jaipur-based private tour operator for India, Nepal and Bhutan since 2007.

> Private, tailor-made tour operator based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, in business since 2007. Plans custom, English-guided private tours across India, Nepal and Bhutan for international travellers — no fixed group departures, no shared coach tours. Every itinerary is built around one traveller's own dates, pace and interests.

## Business Facts

- Founded 2007 by Narendra Poonia, based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.
- IATO-registered (Indian Association of Tour Operators).
- Recognised by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, and by Rajasthan Tourism.
- 4.9-star rating on Google (140+ reviews) and 4.9-star rating on Tripadvisor (282+ reviews), independently.
- Languages spoken: English, French, German, Spanish.
- Every trip includes a private, English-speaking guide and driver, handpicked heritage/luxury hotels chosen per itinerary, and one point of contact from enquiry through to departure.
- Sister companies: Palace on Wheels Tour (palaceonwheelstour.com, luxury train bookings) and Rajasthan Travel Agency (rajasthantravelagency.com, Rajasthan-specific tours).

## What Makes This Operator Different

- Fully private throughout — never a shared group tour with a fixed departure date.
- Direct, first-hand hotel relationships rather than third-party listings.
- Transparent quoting: every quote itemises what's included, with no fees added after the quote is agreed.
- Honest, non-generic advice — the site's own "Why Choose Us" page explicitly acknowledges where a group tour or independent DIY trip may suit a traveller better on price.

## Planning Guides (Travel Guide)

- [Rajasthan Itinerary Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/rajasthan-itinerary-guide): how to plan 7, 10, 12 or 14 days in Rajasthan with real drive times.
- [Trip Cost Calculator](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/tools/trip-cost-calculator): free calculator for a starting price per person across India, Nepal and Bhutan, in your own currency.
- [When to Go Planner](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/tools/when-to-go-planner): best months by destination for the Golden Triangle, Kerala, tiger safaris, Bhutan and Nepal.
- [What to Pack for India: A Practical Packing List](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/what-to-pack-for-india): What to pack by season, temple-friendly dress, shoes, plug adapter, power bank and a small medical kit.
- [Tipping in India: How Much to Tip Drivers, Guides and Hotels](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/tipping-in-india): Typical rupee tips for drivers, guides, restaurants, hotel staff and spas, plus practical tips on small notes.
- [India Etiquette for Tourists: Temples, Dress, Photos and Customs](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-etiquette-for-tourists): What to wear at temples, removing shoes, using your right hand, asking before photographing people and other customs.
- [SIM Card, eSIM and WiFi in India for Tourists](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/sim-card-and-wifi-in-india): International eSIM, an Airtel SIM at the airport or a Jio SIM compared, with costs, documents and coverage.
- [India Visa for US Citizens (2026)](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-visa-for-us-citizens): e-Tourist visa fees, 30-day vs 1-year, stay limits, how to apply and the e-Arrival Card for US travellers.
- [Which Tiger Reserve in India, and When to Go](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/which-tiger-reserve-in-india-and-when-to-go): Ranthambore, Bandhavgarh, Kanha, Pench and Kaziranga compared by month, with closures and permits.
- [Bhutan Travel Guide: Visa, Fees and Best Time](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/bhutan-visa-fee-and-best-time-to-visit): US$40 visa, US$100 per night Sustainable Development Fee (confirmed to 31 Aug 2027), children's rates, seasons and tour cost.
- [Nepal Travel Guide: Visa and Best Time](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/nepal-visa-and-best-time-to-visit): visa on arrival fees, entry tips, seasons and tour cost.
- [10 Days in India: Itinerary for First-Timers](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/10-days-in-india-itinerary): three day-by-day 10-day routes (Rajasthan, Kerala or Varanasi) with costs.
- [2 Weeks in India: 14-Day Itinerary](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/2-weeks-in-india-itinerary): three day-by-day 14-day routes (Rajasthan, Kerala, Nepal or Bhutan) with costs.
- [Golden Triangle Itinerary Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/golden-triangle-itinerary-guide): Delhi–Agra–Jaipur, day by day.
- [Taj Mahal Visiting Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/taj-mahal-visiting-guide): tickets, timings, the Friday closure, sunrise vs. sunset.
- [India e-Visa Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-e-visa-guide): visa types, fees, stay limits by nationality, and the e-Arrival Card.
- [Getting Around India](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/getting-around-india): flights, trains and private road transport compared.
- [How Much Does a Private Tour of India Cost?](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/how-much-does-a-private-tour-of-india-cost): starting prices by trip length and hotel tier, inclusions, and what changes the price.
- [Is India Safe for Tourists?](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/is-india-safe-for-tourists): common scams, women's safety, emergency numbers, how a private trip helps.
- [India Health & Vaccination Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-health-vaccination-guide): general pre-trip health guidance.
- [India Currency & Payments Guide](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/india-currency-payments-guide): cash, cards, ATMs and UPI for visitors.
- [Solo Travel in India](https://colourfulindianholidays.com/travel-guide/solo-travel-india-guide): practical guidance for travelling alone, including for solo women.
